summary: Morgan County, TN tower at about 1,640 ft, listed standing by Tennessee Landforms and in a 2014 Division of Forestry tower nomination table; build date not found.

evidence.supports: Burrville tower in Morgan County at 1,640 feet, listed as standing
the nomination's table lists a Burrville tower in Morgan County
the nomination covers Division of Forestry fire lookout towers from 1933 to 1975
evidence.quote: Tennessee Division of Forestry Fire Lookout Towers, 1933 to 1975
There are 76 lookouts registered in Tennessee.

sources.title: Tennessee Division of Forestry Fire Lookout Towers, 1933 to 1975

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder or staffing source was found in what could be read. A geocache listing, seen only in a search snippet, says the tower was built in 1933 and names a Division of Forestry lookout operator from the 1940s. Its page returned no text to fetch_text, so the claim is not cited or used in the story; verify it through the Division of Forestry or a Morgan County history before adding it. Record elevation_m 499.9 matches 1,640 ft. Access, owner and condition unknown. The NHLR Tennessee list has no Burrville entry. Read and search budgets are used up for this record.
